thread:
Sarah (Sales): inbound SIG/CAIQ from WispHealth — they attached CAIQ + custom KMS/BYOK questions. POC scheduled Mon, want answers before kickoff. @Devon - can security own intake and give ETA?
Devon - SecEng: got it. can you drop the files here (zip or link)? I'll triage.
Amy R: adding context — I'm SE on the POC. They expect BYOK, tokenization, and audit logs. concurrency ~10 rps, ~200k tokens/day, some PHI.
Jordan L: heads-up on pricing side — if they require Dedicated + BYOK + SLA uplift, cost impact will be material. need to know their commitment horizon.
Sarah (Sales): files uploaded: https://wisphealth-share /CAIQ-v2.zip (note: redacted in slack link)
SecBot: New intake ticket created: RWD-5231 — Security questionnaire intake for WispHealth.
Devon - SecEng: quick skim: high-risk asks = BYOK (customer-managed keys / HSM), data residency, SOC2 evidence, pen test report, SOC logs retention, BAA. Can you confirm if they will sign a BAA?
Sarah (Sales): sales confirmed they will sign BAA; legal looped in and said they"'ll aim to return signed doc this week.
Amy R: FYI for POC: typical model access is chat + embeddings; occasional long docs (PII/PHI) for summarization. We'll route sensitive jobs to Dedicated if needed.
Devon - SecEng: PHI expands scope — mark high priority. I need sample prompt patterns and where data will transit. Also infra to provide diagrams and logging retention settings. @eng-infra can you help with infra diagrams + certs?
eng-infra: noted, INF-889 opened for diagram + cert links. We'll pull SOC2 link and KMS architecture diagrams.
Jordan L: for pricing: draft quote attached in shared drive. If they go Dedicated + BYOK + BAA + 99.9% SLA, expect ~35% uplift versus hosted. Also flag: enterprise onboarding lead time 2-3 wks.
Devon - SecEng: plan: 1) full CAIQ answers — 48 hrs, 2) technical evidence (certs/pen test) — 3-5 business days once infra provides materials, 3) BYOK design review — depends on HSM vendor, estimate 5 business days.
Sarah (Sales): can we compress CAIQ to 36 hrs? customer wants answers before Mon POC start.
Devon - SecEng: I can aim for 36 hrs for initial CAIQ answers if Amy/Azure infra help get certs quickly. But BYOK design can't be rushed safely.
Amy R: I'll surface the BYOK constraints to the customer and offer a temporary protective config (no PHI on hosted) so POC can proceed if they accept limitations.
Jordan L: noted — we should include a pricing addendum for BYOK integration and an upfront implementation fee.
Devon - SecEng: marking assignees: Devon - SecEng, Amy R. I'll post status updates here. Starting triage now.
SecBot: RWD-5231 status -> in_progress (assignees: Devon - SecEng, Amy R).
Sarah (Sales): great, please ping if anything blocks legal or eng. putting this thread on urgent. :thumbsup:
Devon - SecEng: one more ask — please provide sample SLA/throughput expectations in plain bullets so I can map controls to risk.
Amy R: sample bullets: 10 rps sustained, bursts to 25 rps, 200k tokens/day, mainly text+embeddings, occasional PDF extraction of medical notes.
Devon - SecEng: perfect. I'll update CAIQ answers and flag items requiring evidence. Expect first batch of answers in ~12-36 hrs.
Sarah (Sales): thanks team. looping back to customer with this timeline.
SecBot: RWD-5231 comment: "evidence requested: SOC2 report, pen-test summary, KMS architecture diagram".
Sarah (Sales): ack. will follow up with customer for certs if they have them. :email:
Devon - SecEng: adding this to the weekly security intake dashboard and will escalate if legal doesn't return BAA.
Amy R: pinged legal separately.
Jordan L: noted on pricing path — will keep the quote ready but hold final send until security ack.
Sarah (Sales): thanks all.
Devon - SecEng: closing loop here after triage pass, will post updates in this thread as evidence arrives and when BYOK design meeting scheduled.
SecBot: RWD-5231 status -> evidence_requested
Sarah (Sales): thanks :thumbsup:
